spans.s: लल् (I) vi. 1U (pres. ललति-ते) To play, to sport, to dally, गजकलभा इव बंधुला ललामः Mrich.iv.
लल् (II) vi. 10U (pres. लालयति-ते) 1. To caress, to fondle, to coax, लालयेत्पंच वर्षाणि दश वर्षाणि ताडयेत् Chan.; 2. to desire.
लल् (III) vt. 10U (pres. ललयति-ते) 1. To desire; 2. to loll the tongue.
लल a. (f. ला) 1. Playful, sportive; 2. wishing, desirous.
लल a. (f. ला) 1. Playful, sportive; 2. wishing, desirous.
लाला f. Spittle, saliva, Rt.i.21.
लल-जिह्व m. the same as ललज्जिह्व q.v.
ललज्जिह्व m. 1. A dog; 2. a camel.
ललन n. 1. Sport, pleasure, dalliance; 2. lolling the tongue.
ललना f. 1. A woman in general, ललनालक्षैर्न संलक्षिताः Git.G.iii.; 2. a wanton woman; 3. the tongue.
लालन n. 1. Caressing, fondling, e.g. लालने बहवो दोषास्ताडने बहवो गुणाः; 2. indulging.
ललना-प्रिय m. the kadamba tree.
ललनिका f. A little woman, K.D.iii.50.
ललंतिका f. 1. A long necklace; 2. a lizard.
ललाक m. The penis.
ललाट n. The forehead, लिपिं ललाटेऽर्थिजनस्य जाग्रतीम् Na.i.15, Sis.iv.28.
ललाट-अक्ष m. an epithet of Śiva.
ललाट-तट n. the slope of the forehead.
ललाटंतप (I) a. burning the forehead, ललाटंतपसप्तसप्तिः R.xiii.41, लिपिर्ललाटंतपनिष्ठुराक्षरा Na.i.138.
ललाटंतप (II) m. the sun.
ललाट-पट्ट n. 1. a tiara; 2. the flat surface of the forehead.
ललाट-पट्टिका f. 1. a tiara; 2. the flat surface of the forehead.
ललाटक n. 1. The forehead; 2. a beautiful forehead.
ललाटिका f. 1. An ornament worn on the forehead; 2. a mark made with some fragrant powder on the forehead.
लालाटिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to the forehead; 2. useless, low; 3. dependant on destiny, प्राप्तिस्तु लालाटिकी Ud.
लालाटिक (II) m. 1. An attendent who watches his masters countenance and learns by it what is necessary to be done; 2. an idler, who is a burden to his patron; 3. a particular embrace.
ललाटूल a. (f. ला) Having a handsome forehead.
ललाटूल a. (f. ला) Having a handsome forehead.
ललाम (I) a. (f. मी) Beautiful, charming.
ललाम (II) m.n. An ornament for the forehead, an ornament in general, अहं तु तामाश्रमललामभूतां शकुंतलामधिकृत्य ब्रवीमि Sak.ii., Sis.iv.8.
ललाम (III) m. A horse.
ललाम (IV) n. 1. A mark on the forehead; 2. a banner, a flag; 3. a row, a line; 4. a horn; 5. a tail; 6. a mane; 7. eminence, dignity; 8. anything the best of its kind.
ललाम (I) a. (f. मी) Beautiful, charming.
ललामक n. A chaplet of flowers worn on the forehead.
ललामन् n. 1. An ornament, a decoration; 2. a banner, a flag; 3. a sectarial mark; 4. a sign, a symbol; 5. a tail; 6. anything the best of its kind, कन्याललाम कमनीयमजस्य लिप्सोः R.v.64.

ललित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Playing, dallying, wanton, voluptuous; 2. handsome, beautiful, elegant, विधाय सृष्टिं ललितां विधातुः R.vi.37, xix.39, K.S.iii.75, Megh.i.32; 3. pleasing, agreeable, desired, ललिताभिनयं तमद्य भर्ता मरुतां द्रष्टुमनाः सलोकपालः Vikr.ii., प्रियशिष्या ललिते कलाविधौ R.viii.67, K.S.vii.19; 4. trembling, tremulous; 5. soft, gentle.
ललित (II) n. 1. Sport, dalliance; 2. beauty, charm; 3. languid gestures in a woman; 4. simplicity, innocence.

ललित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Playing, dallying, wanton, voluptuous; 2. handsome, beautiful, elegant, विधाय सृष्टिं ललितां विधातुः R.vi.37, xix.39, K.S.iii.75, Megh.i.32; 3. pleasing, agreeable, desired, ललिताभिनयं तमद्य भर्ता मरुतां द्रष्टुमनाः सलोकपालः Vikr.ii., प्रियशिष्या ललिते कलाविधौ R.viii.67, K.S.vii.19; 4. trembling, tremulous; 5. soft, gentle.
ललिता f. 1. An epithet of Durgā; 2. a woman in general; 3. a wanton woman; 4. musk.
लालित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Caressed, fondled, seduced; 2. loved, desired.
लालित (II) n. Pleasure, love.
लालित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Caressed, fondled, seduced; 2. loved, desired.
ललित-अर्थ n. having an amorous meaning.
ललित-पद a. elegantly composed.
ललित-प्रहार m. a gentle blow.
ललिता-पंचमी f. the fifth day of the first half of Āśvina.
ललिता-सप्तमी f. the seventh day of the first half of Bhādrapada.
लालस (I) a. (f. सा) 1. Ardently desirous of, ईशानसंदर्शनलालसानाम् K.S.vii.56; 2. devoted to, finding pleasure in, अनेकनारीपरिरंभसंभ्रमस्फुरन्मनोहरि विलासलालसम् Git.G.i.
लालस (I) a. (f. सा) 1. Ardently desirous of, ईशानसंदर्शनलालसानाम् K.S.vii.56; 2. devoted to, finding pleasure in, अनेकनारीपरिरंभसंभ्रमस्फुरन्मनोहरि विलासलालसम् Git.G.i.
लालसा f. 1. Ardent desire, eagerness; 2. entreating, solicitation; 3. regret, sorrow; 4. the longing of a pregnant woman.
लालसीक n. Sauce.
लाला-स्राव m. 1. a spider; 2. a flow of saliva.
लालाटिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to the forehead; 2. useless, low; 3. dependant on destiny, प्राप्तिस्तु लालाटिकी Ud.
लालाटी f. The forehead.
लालिक m. A buffalo.
लालितक m. A fondling, a pet, a little favourite.
लालित्य n. 1. Loveliness, grace, charm, beauty, as in पदलालित्य; 2. amorous gestures.
लालिन् m. A seducer.
लालिनी f. A wanton woman.
लालुका f. A kind of necklace.
